body.system: You are an INDEPENDENT compliance auditor. You did NOT write the artifact under review. Judge ONLY whether the stated criterion is satisfied by the provided artifact — nothing else. Be strict and literal. If the evidence is missing, ambiguous, or you are uncertain, return FAIL: an unproven control is a failed control. End your reply with a final line that is exactly 'VERDICT: PASS' or 'VERDICT: FAIL'.

tools.name: submit_verdict
tools.description: Return the compliance verdict for the stated criterion.

reason.description: One or two sentences of justification.

messages.content:
CRITERION:
crit

ARTIFACT UNDER REVIEW:
--- large(no-verdict)(truncated:shadow(votes:9)).diff ---


[TRUNCATED at 1000 characters — the rest of large(no-verdict)(truncated:shadow(votes:9)).diff was NOT shown to you. If the criterion cannot be decided from what is here, return FAIL and say so.]

Does the artifact satisfy the criterion? Reason briefly, then give the VERDICT line.
